info.name: Multiplier API
info.description: Multiplier (usemultiplier.com) global employment platform. The Multiplier API is an integration surface accessed with account-provisioned Service User tokens, not an open self-serve API. Multiplier does not publish an endpoint-level public reference, so this collection documents the authenticated resource areas (members, contracts, payroll, payments, time off, invoices) as folders without fabricated request paths. The Authorization header carries the Service User token. Not to be confused with docs.multiplierhq.com, an unrelated product.
